title: Letting an accounting firm send entries into this company
summary: Give your bookkeeper or accountant's own Celerp a pairing link so their postings land straight in your books.

steps.text: Create a pairing link for the firm, then hand it to them; every link you have issued is listed under {grants}.
You can also ask the assistant which firms can send entries, or to create, renew or revoke a pairing link. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
